descriptionByLocale.it: Immergersi in tutte le sfaccettature del lavoro amministrativo e commerciale consente di scoprire una professione ricca e varia Tra gestione dei casi, elaborazione delle applicazioni e organizzazione quotidiana, si impara a evolversi in un ambiente strutturato Ogni scambio con i clienti interni ed esterni è un'opportunità per sviluppare le proprie competenze relazionali e il senso del servizio Scoprire diversi settori di attività ti dà una visione globale e arricchente dell'azienda Parallelamente, sviluppi competenze professionali, metodologiche, sociali e personali che ti serviranno durante la tua carriera La combinazione di teoria e pratica, sia a scuola che in affari, rende il vostro apprendimento concreto e motivante
descriptionByLocale.en: Immersing yourself in all facets of administrative and commercial work allows you to discover a rich and varied profession Between case management, application processing and daily organisation, you learn how to evolve in a structured environment Every exchange with internal and external clients is an opportunity to develop your relational skills and your sense of service Discovering different sectors of activity gives you a global and enriching vision of the company In parallel, you develop professional, methodological, social and personal skills that will serve you throughout your career The combination of theory and practice, both at school and in business, makes your learning concrete and motivating

Die Kombination von Theorie und Praxis, sowohl in der Schule als auch in der Wirtschaft, macht Ihr Lernen konkret und motivierend

descriptionByLocale.en: You professionally advise clients in the areas of health insurance, life insurance, wealth and solutions for businesses Through cross-selling and upselling, you develop trust relationships and help strengthen their loyalty The acquisition of new customers, whether it comes from internal initiatives or recommendations, is an integral part of your daily life.
